title: The Georgetown 403
meta_description: Minimalist chic, modern design, and casual coastal vibes combine to create a breathtaking oasis at The Georgetown 403, a classic condominium in the center of Rosemary Beach. With space for eight, this elegant home places you in the center of it all.
description_expanded: DescriptionMinimalist chic, modern design, and casual coastal vibes combine to create a breathtaking oasis at The Georgetown 403— a classic condominium located in the convenient center of Rosemary Beach. With space for eight, this elegant home is ideal for couples or families traveling together, as the thoughtfully designed layout allows for plenty of privacy. You’ll also enjoy being close to nearly everything— the delicious local-favorite restaurants, the casual coffee cafes, the eclectic shops, and of course the glittering turquoise waves of the Gulf.In the stylish main living area, the sofa and armchairs are soothing shades of cream and gray, creating a luxurious yet completely comfy spot to curl up with a good book or movie. Doors leading out to the sunny balcony also allow the sunlight to flood the interior space, while artistic light fixtures add even more illumination.A dining table with seating for six is accompanied by a built-in sideboard/wet bar with a wine fridge and shelves filled with glass stemware. The bright, pristine kitchen features an island with bar stool seating. Dove gray cabinets, gleaming quartz countertops, and a herringbone-tiled backsplash combine to create an elegant yet completely efficient space for preparing the morning coffee and warm blueberry muffins. Premier, stainless appliances include a spacious refrigerator, dishwasher, and a Wolf gas range.The Georgetown 403 features two bedrooms suites, each located on either end of the home for maximum privacy. The primary suite has a luxe king-size bed set against a charcoal-gray upholstered headboard and facing the HDTV. The ensuite primary bathroom is accessed by two sliding barn doors and includes a dual marble-topped vanity, deep soaking tub, and step-in shower. The secondary suite also has a king-size bed, HDTV, and ensuite bathroom with a freestanding tub, double vanity, and glass-enclosed shower— as well as access to the balcony. Two additional sleeping spaces include a bunk nook in the hallway with a twin-over-twin berth and a guest bedroom with a queen-size bed and HDTV.The sun-kissed balcony spaces at The Georgetown 403 provide sweeping views of charming Rosemary Beach and remind you that you are right in the center of one of the most picturesque coastal towns. Step out your door and onto the cobblestoned streets— and take a stroll to the beach for the day, or perhaps an afternoon of shopping and a leisurely lunch at a nearby cafe. In the evening, walk to dinner and an outdoor concert. It’s all right at your fingertips at The Georgetown 403. This home also boasts 4 private community swimming pools and a dedicated, covered parking space.PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:* Professionally designed* Views of town* Sunny balconies* Dedicated parking space* 4 private community swimming pools* Easy walk to the beach (3-4 Minutes)* 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes* Clean Bedding ProgramMAIN FLOOR : (Sleeps 8)* Open LIVING AREA with BALCONY* Gourmet KITCHEN and DINING AREA with WET BAR* PRIMARY SUITE with a king-size bed, and ensuite BATH (Sleeps 2)* SECONDARY SUITE with a king-size bed, ensuite BATH, and BALCONY access (Sleeps 2)* SLEEPING NOOK with twin-over-twin-size bunk beds (Sleeps 2)* BEDROOM with a queen-size bed (Sleeps 2) * FULL BATHROOM
